title: Retrieval Augmented Generation
text: Retrieval augmented generation retrieves relevant documents before generating an answer. The retrieved documents are inserted into the prompt so the language model can answer using external knowledge instead of relying only on its parameters. A retrieval system usually embeds chunks of text and compares the query embedding with document embeddings.

title: FAISS Vector Search
text: FAISS is a library for efficient similarity search over dense vectors. It can perform exact or approximate nearest neighbor search. In retrieval systems, FAISS is often used to index document embeddings and quickly return the most similar vectors for a query embedding.

title: Contrastive Learning
text: Contrastive learning trains representation models by pulling related examples closer in embedding space and pushing unrelated examples farther apart. In retrieval training, a query and its relevant document are treated as a positive pair, while other documents act as negatives.

title: Judo Kuzushi
text: In judo, kuzushi means breaking the opponent's balance. A throw usually becomes easier after the attacker creates kuzushi through pulling, pushing, footwork, timing, or forcing the opponent to react. Kuzushi is a central principle in many throwing techniques.

title: Gradient Descent
text: Gradient descent is an optimization algorithm that updates model parameters using gradients. The gradient points in the direction of steepest increase of the loss, so gradient descent moves parameters in the opposite direction to reduce the loss.
